title: Deep neural network prediction of genome-wide transcriptome signatures - beyond the Black-box.
summary: The primary article uses a deep neural network to predict transcriptome signatures from transcription-factor expression and reports specific regulatory and disease-associated patterns; these are model-derived biological findings, not experimentally confirmed causal mechanisms.
